keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Haledon Borough, homeowners pay an average of $11,392.23 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 13.83% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 51.19%, assessed values average ~51.19% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 51.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 32.4%, and Passaic County claims 16.4%.
